title: ArcCivs 0.1.87: builder upkeep of accepted autonomous roads
assumptions: Low/base/high sensitivities assume 1/4/6 active cities and 0.25/1/4 active hours per city-day, with 16/64/256 actually changed road cells. These are activity assumptions, not live measurements; no native client, observer or world edits used for this review.

Before: no regular builder upkeep; old completed plans remain immutable. After: one changed centerline floor cell consumes exactly1 abstract STONE, placing COBBLESTONE or a dry bottom COBBLESTONE_STAIRS block. Already healthy cells cost0; no native drops, refunds, inventory output or resident training reward.

Upkeep is Auto-only, after construction/queue priority, with the ordinary next building goal's stone cost reserved. No new building, infrastructure/population/stock limit, money fee, WOOD/FOOD charge or producer payout. Receipt accepts exact stock debit and cycle once before native mutation; uncertain outcomes recover through the same receipt.

Three-second single-cell work gives a deliberately loose upper ceiling1200 cells per real active hour before actual walking, cooldown, sleep, aggregate native budgets and available surplus stock. No offline catch-up. Existing quarry60-second delivery yields180/360/540 abstractSTONE per quarry-worker-hour at L1/L2/L3 before travel and other constraints. Quarry ORE cycles are alternative to STONE, not additive.

The native floor blocks are real world output from the existing privileged Auto stock-to-world bridge; abstract stock itself is not withdrawable. Accepted access centerlines outside protected building footprints remain publicly breakable under the current protection contract. No new ownership/protection restriction is introduced; do not claim an unbreakable road.

An adversarial player can mine new publicly accessible flat COBBLESTONE and force repeated paid upkeep while surplus stone lasts. This is a disk quote, not an in-memory quote or measured player sale; stair sale value is not established and not invented.

Conditional flat-cobble resale is a separate alternative scenario: one mined cobble per maintenance cell at nominal0.05 Vault, with actual sale access and unchanged quote assumed. It does not occur automatically and must not be added to world blocks retained on those same repaired cells. Native removed grass/dirt creates no extra drop.

Direct Vault, tokens, playerXP and resident-jobXP are separately0. No new earning multiplier; existing Trails registration uses only its existing one surface multiplier. Improved walk availability can recover existing throughput but is not measured or given a fabricated percentage.
Current EconomyShopGUI SELL is the current conditional redemption scenario; planned SELL-off/contracts remains future and is not treated as active zero-price redemption.

Decision: approve a finite actual-stock sink and one native block per changed surface cell, retaining next-building reserve and no payouts. The loose builder ceiling corresponds to60 nominal Vault/hour only if every repaired flat block is repeatedly mined and actually sold; steady raw-STONE replacement by one L1/L2/L3 quarry worker is atmost9/18/27 nominal Vault/hour before constraints. Administrative stock grants are not sustainable ordinary income.

Flowers/decor and other unsupported cover cause the floor to be skipped; no later physics-induced item issuance is authorized.
